name: Plant Nerd | Platinum Pave
description:
Platinum Pavé (pronounced pa-vay) is a cross of Spritzer and Pavé bred by Compound Genetics. The flower’s nose has a mix of Champagne sweetness, effervescent cream soda, and diesel. The flavors really come through on slower burning hand rolls and joints. It’s quickly becoming one of our favorite strains.

Cross: Spritzer x Pavé

Category: Hybrid
